6	                  cross-checked against the build's columns), describe Foundation P&L by regime and hour on IS, run the
7	                  pre-registered gate grid on IS, select a candidate on IS only. Writes h2_<tf>_*.csv/json.
8	    --stage oos   read the IS choice, evaluate the chosen gate and the pre-registered CHoCH-count gates (k = 2, 3, 4)
9	                  once on OOS (and on IS with the final 2000 draws), plus the OOS bucket tables with IS-defined edges.
10	
11	PRE-REGISTERED DEFINITIONS (fixed before any number was read)
12	  Unit = Foundation SETUP with its own engine trade (entry at the SETUP close), outcome = net INR at lot 65 after
13	  5 pts slippage per side and lab.trade_charges (the build's fnd_net / fnd_net_inr), win = net > 0, loser = net <= 0.
14	  Events = engine CHoCH / BOS events with bar i <= k (the SETUP bar), in engine order (BOS before CHoCH on one bar).
15	  Regime features at SETUP bar k (all as-of, bars <= k only):
16	    n_choch_since_bos      CHoCH events after the last BOS (all CHoCHs when no BOS yet). The SETUP's own CHoCH counts
17	                           (it is at ch < k), so 1 = own CHoCH only, 0 = a BOS came after the own CHoCH before k,
18	                           >= 2 = "CHoCH, CHoCH, no BOS" (the user's sideways).
19	    n_choch_since_bos_today  the same count restricted to events of the SETUP's session (a BOS in an earlier session
20	                           does not reset today's count; the session start does).
21	    n_flip_since_bos       of the CHoCHs since the last BOS, the ones that flipped the trend.
22	    n_bos_since_choch      BOS events after the last CHoCH (>= 1 = the move already broke structure before the SETUP).
23	    bars_since_choch       k - ch (the SETUP's own CHoCH bar).
24	    bars_since_bos         k - bar of the last BOS (NaN when none yet); last_bos_agree = its direction == SETUP dir.
25	    alt_dir6               direction changes between consecutive events among the last 6 events (0..5).
26	    alt_kind6              kind changes (BOS<->CHoCH) among the last 6 events (0..5).
27	    n_choch_1h / n_bos_1h / n_choch_3h / n_bos_3h   events with k - N < i <= k, N = 60/180 bars (1m) or 12/36 (5m).
28	    range_1h_atr, range_3h_atr   (max high - min low) over bars max(session start, k-N+1) .. k, / atr14[k]
29	                           (same session only: the overnight gap never enters).
30	    range_since_choch_atr  the same over bars ch .. k.
31	    session_range_atr      the same over the session's bars up to k; pos_in_session_range = (close - low)/range.
32	    er_1h                  Kaufman efficiency ratio |c[k]-c[k-N]| / sum|c[j]-c[j-1]| over the last N bars of the
33	                           session (N = 1h, at least 5 bars; NaN otherwise). Descriptive only, not in the grid.
34	  Gate grid (skip = do not take the SETUP):
35	    choch rule: skip when n_choch_since_bos >= kc (scope all) or n_choch_since_bos_today >= kc (scope today),
36	                kc in {2, 3, 4}; or no choch rule.
37	    range rule: skip when range_W_atr <= r, W in {1h, 3h, since_choch}, r = the IS quantile q in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3,
38	                0.4, 0.5} of that range over IS SETUPs (the ATR multiple is recorded); or no range rule.
39	    combine: OR / AND when both rules are present.
40	  Gate metrics: kept / skipped n, net sums and means, diff = kept mean - skipped mean, win rates, loser recall
41	    (skipped losers / all losers), skip precision (skipped losers / skipped), winners skipped share (skipped winners /
42	    all winners) and winner-net skipped share (net of skipped winners / net of all winners), session-matched random
43	    control percentile (fz_report.random_control: per session, as many Foundation trades drawn at random as the gate
44	    kept; kept net's percentile among the draws), and the kept-vs-skipped permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p).
45	  Selection on IS (before OOS is touched): eligible = kept share >= 0.30 and skipped n >= 100. Score = IS control
46	    percentile, tie-break = diff. Among the top 5 by score, the chosen cell is the first whose diff > 0 in at least
47	    3 of the 4 IS year blocks (2021-10..2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); if none, no gate survives IS.

"""Pre-registration run (before any candidate is scored): the splitter checks, the break tests of the book's own expectancy
(they decide the time-decay weighting and the OOS caveat), the raw Foundation book and the frozen ST7/ST8 gate on both labels
and both timeframes (the comparators every OOS table carries). Writes results/pre_registration.json and the first ledger rows.

    python pre_register.py
"""
import os, sys, json
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import numpy as np
import harness as H

out = {}
for tf in ("minute", "5minute"):
    for label in ("L1", "L0"):
        T = H.load(tf, label)
        rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
        raw = dict(units_is=int(len(rows)), units_oos=int(T.oos_mask.sum()), is_net=round(float(T.net[rows].sum()), 2),
                   is_mean=round(float(T.net[rows].mean()), 2), is_win_rate=round(float(T.win[rows].mean()), 4),
                   is_active_sessions=int(len(T.active_sessions)), is_sessions_median_setups=float(np.median(np.bincount(T.session[rows])[np.bincount(T.session[rows]) > 0])),
                   top_decile_winner_share_of_gross_wins=round(float(np.sort(T.net[rows][T.win[rows]])[-max(1, int(0.1 * T.win[rows].sum())):].sum() / T.net[rows][T.win[rows]].sum()), 4),
                   mean_cost_inr=round(float((T.F.loc[rows, ("l1_cost_inr" if label == "L1" else "fnd_cost_inr")].to_numpy(dtype=float)).mean()), 2))
        frozen = T.F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy()
        fz = H.score(T, frozen, "comparator/frozen_st7_st8", dict(gate="ST7/ST8 as traded (fz_traded)"), script=__file__, note="the frozen v2 gate, the comparator")
        rec = dict(splits=H.check_splits(T) if label == "L1" else None, raw_book=raw,
                   frozen_gate={k: fz[k] for k in ("id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "diff_top1_removed", "kept_mean_slip8",
                                                    "perm_p", "control_pct", "loser_recall", "loser_precision", "winner_recall", "winner_recall_weighted",
                                                    "top_decile_winners_skipped", "sign_blocks", "kept_pf")},
                   frozen_go_no_go=H.go_no_go(fz, tf)[1])
        if label == "L1": rec["break_tests"] = H.break_tests(T)
        out[f"{tf}/{label}"] = rec
        print(tf, label, "units", raw["units_is"], "mean", raw["is_mean"], "| frozen diff", fz["diff"], "pct", fz["control_pct"], "p", fz["perm_p"], flush=True)
out["go_no_go_rule"] = H.GO
out["ledger_sha_after"] = H.ledger_sha()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(HERE, "results"), exist_ok=True)
json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(HERE, "results", "pre_registration.json"), "w"), indent=1, default=str)
print("written results/pre_registration.json")

197	                stop_share=round((d.reason == "stop_loss").mean(), 4), cost_mean=round((d.charges + SLIP_INR).mean(), 2),
198	                sessions=int(d.sess.nunique()))

201	def bucket_table(d, col, bins, tf, win, draws, labels=None):
202	    """Foundation outcome by bucket of `col`, each bucket vs its complement with a permutation p."""
203	    x = d[col]
204	    if bins is None:
205	        cat = x.astype("object").where(x.notna(), "nan")
206	    else:
207	        cat = pd.cut(x, bins=bins, labels=labels, include_lowest=True, right=True).astype("object").where(x.notna(), "nan")
208	    rows = []
209	    for b in (list(dict.fromkeys(labels)) if labels else sorted(cat.unique(), key=lambda v: (str(v) == "nan", v if isinstance(v, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) else str(v)))):
210	        m = cat == b
211	        if m.sum() == 0: continue
212	        s = stats(d[m]); comp = d[~m]
213	        p = fz_report.permutation_p(list(comp.net), list(d[m].net), draws, SEED, f"{tf}|{win}|{col}|{b}") if len(comp) and m.sum() else {}
214	        rows.append(dict(col=col, bucket=str(b), **s, diff_vs_rest=p.get("diff"), perm_p=p.get("p")))
215	    return rows
216

218	def evaluate(d, skip, draws, tf, win, cell):
219	    kept, skp = d[~skip], d[skip]
220	    out = dict(cell=cell, window=win, n=len(d), n_kept=len(kept), n_skipped=len(skp), kept_share=round(len(kept) / len(d), 4),
221	               net_all=round(d.net.sum(), 2), net_kept=round(kept.net.sum(), 2), net_skipped=round(skp.net.sum(), 2),
222	               mean_kept=round(kept.net.mean(), 2) if len(kept) else None, mean_skipped=round(skp.net.mean(), 2) if len(skp) else None,
223	               win_rate_kept=round(kept.win.mean(), 4) if len(kept) else None, win_rate_skipped=round(skp.win.mean(), 4) if len(skp) else None,
224	               pts_kept=round(kept.pts.sum(), 2), pts_skipped=round(skp.pts.sum(), 2),
225	               sessions_kept=int(kept.sess.nunique()), sessions_all=int(d.sess.nunique()))
226	    losers, winners = d.net <= 0, d.net > 0
227	    out.update(loser_recall=round((skip & losers).sum() / losers.sum(), 4) if losers.sum() else None,
228	               skip_precision=round((skip & losers).sum() / skip.sum(), 4) if skip.sum() else None,
229	               winners_skipped_share=round((skip & winners).sum() / winners.sum(), 4) if winners.sum() else None,
230	               winner_net_skipped_share=round(d.net[skip & winners].sum() / d.net[winners].sum(), 4) if winners.sum() else None,
231	               stop_share_kept=round((kept.reason == "stop_loss").mean(), 4) if len(kept) else None,
232	               stop_share_skipped=round((skp.reason == "stop_loss").mean(), 4) if len(skp) else None)
233	    if len(kept) and len(skp):
234	        ctl = fz_report.random_control(units(d, "RAW"), units(kept, "TAKE"), draws, SEED, f"{tf}|{win}|{cell}")
235	        perm = fz_report.permutation_p(list(kept.net), list(skp.net), draws, SEED, f"{tf}|{win}|{cell}")
236	        out.update(control_pct=ctl["fz_pct"], control_p_beat=ctl["p_beat"], control_p5=ctl["p5"], control_p50=ctl["p50"],
237	                   control_p95=ctl["p95"], control_draws=draws, control_capped=ctl["capped"], diff=perm["diff"], perm_p=perm["p"])
238	    else:
239	        out.update(control_pct=None, control_p_beat=None, control_p5=None, control_p50=None, control_p95=None, control_draws=draws,
240	                   control_capped=None, diff=None, perm_p=None)
241	    return out

244	def rule_mask(d, kc, scope, rw, r, combine):
245	    m_ch = None if kc is None else ((d["n_choch_since_bos"] if scope == "all" else d["n_choch_since_bos_today"]) >= kc)
246	    m_r = None if rw is None else (d[f"range_{rw}_atr"] <= r)
247	    if m_ch is None and m_r is None: return None
248	    if m_ch is None: return m_r.values
249	    if m_r is None: return m_ch.values
250	    return (m_ch | m_r).values if combine == "OR" else (m_ch & m_r).values

1	"""H1 gate audit (BRIEF H1) through the harness: what do the frozen ST7 (1 min) / ST8 (5 min) gates skip vs keep by
2	Foundation outcome? IS only; labels L1 (primary) and L0 (robustness).
3	
4	    python h1_gate_audit.py            # both timeframes, both labels; writes CSV / JSON / TABLES.md next to this file
5	
6	Definitions (fixed before any number was looked at):
7	  unit        a harness row: a Foundation SETUP taken under the label's book (harness.load(tf, label)); IS rows only
8	  kept        T.F.fz_traded: ST7/ST8 held a position on this SETUP (a TAKE, or a REENTER whose R5 was this SETUP). It is the
9	              frozen gate's kept set and is post-SETUP (the comparator, never a feature)
10	  gate_at     fz_gate (as of the SETUP bar); outcome_gate = fzpost_outcome_gate (post-SETUP: REENTER when a later REENTER
11	              used the SETUP as its R5)
12	  block_key   'BLOCK:<fz_block_reason>' when outcome_gate == BLOCK; 'WATCH:<fz_block_reason>' when outcome_gate == WATCH
13	              and a block reason is set (a refused TAKE branch that fell through to WATCH, e.g. leave_into_recycle);
14	              otherwise the outcome_gate itself (TAKE / REENTER / WATCH). Same definition as the local h1_common.py
15	  loser       label net <= 0 (costs included); winner = net > 0
16	  precision   P(loser | skipped); recall = P(skipped | loser); lift = precision / base loser rate (1.0 = random skipping)
17	  winner recall   count: P(kept | winner); |net|-weighted: kept winners' net / all winners' net
18	  big winner  label pts >= 50; huge >= 100 (the "late runners")
19	  pts bucket  (<=-50, (-50,-20], (-20,0], (0,20], (20,50], (50,100], >100); hold bucket (bars) 1-5, 6-15, 16-30, 31-60,
20	              61-120, 121-375, >375 on both timeframes (bars, not minutes)
21	  visit bin   fz_visit_n: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4+ / none (no ref room)
22	  variants    (all pre-declared; every one is a ledger row under family h1/<variant>)
23	              frozen                    keep = fz_traded
24	              take_only                 keep = fz_gate == TAKE (as of the bar)
25	              take_or_reenter_at_setup  keep = fz_gate in (TAKE, REENTER) (as of the bar)
26	              not_block                 keep = fzpost_outcome_gate != BLOCK (WATCH rows treated as taken; DIAGNOSTIC: uses a
27	                                        post column)
28	              skip_only:<block_key>     keep = block_key != key (skip only that key; DIAGNOSTIC: block_key uses the post
29	                                        outcome gate)
30	  FZ book     the ST7/ST8 position's own net on the kept rows (fzpos_l1_net_inr under L1, fzpos_net_inr under L0; REENTER
31	              fills a bar later and exits by its own rules, e.g. band_reclaim), Foundation's label net on the other rows;
32	              scored as label '<label>_fzpos' under family h1/fz_book. The selection-only book = frozen on the label itself
33	  bridge      Foundation IS net -> FZ book net = avoided price move of the skipped rows (-sum pts x 65) + avoided costs of
34	              the skipped rows (sum cost_inr = charges + 2 x 5 pts x 65 slippage) + REENTER exit delta (fzpos net - label net
35	              on kept rows). Cost avoidance is what any gate that trades less collects: reported, never counted as edge
36	  group tables  descriptive decompositions of the frozen ledger row by as-of and post columns (no rule is chosen on them)

114	def group_table(x, by):
115	    g = x.groupby(by, observed=True, dropna=False)
116	    k = x[x.kept == 1].groupby(by, observed=True, dropna=False); s = x[x.kept == 0].groupby(by, observed=True, dropna=False)
117	    t = pd.DataFrame(dict(n=g.size(), kept=g.kept.sum(), kept_share=g.kept.mean().round(4), net=g.net.sum().round(2),
118	                          mean=g.net.mean().round(2), win_rate=g.win.mean().round(4), winners=g.win.sum(), pts=g.pts.sum().round(2),
119	                          big=g.big.sum(), big_skipped=s.big.sum(), huge=g.huge.sum(), huge_skipped=s.huge.sum(),
120	                          kept_net=k.net.sum().round(2), skipped_net=s.net.sum().round(2), kept_mean=k.net.mean().round(2),
121	                          skipped_mean=s.net.mean().round(2), kept_win_rate=k.win.mean().round(4), skipped_win_rate=s.win.mean().round(4)))
122	    for c in ("kept_net", "skipped_net", "big_skipped", "huge_skipped"): t[c] = t[c].fillna(0)
123	    t["kept_minus_skipped"] = (t.kept_mean - t.skipped_mean).round(2)
124	    return t.reset_index()

127	def two_way(x, a, b):
128	    ct = x.pivot_table(index=a, columns=b, values="net", aggfunc=["count", "sum", "mean"], observed=True, fill_value=0)
129	    ct.columns = [f"{s}_{c}" for s, c in ct.columns]
130	    w = x.pivot_table(index=a, columns=b, values="win", aggfunc="sum", observed=True, fill_value=0)
131	    for c in w.columns: ct[f"winners_{c}"] = w[c]
132	    return ct.round(2).reset_index()

135	def md_table(df, cols=None, maxrows=40):
136	    df = df if cols is None else df[cols]
137	    df = df.head(maxrows)
138	    head = "| " + " | ".join(str(c) for c in df.columns) + " |\n|" + "---|" * len(df.columns) + "\n"
139	    body = "".join("| " + " | ".join("" if (isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v)) else (f"{v:,.2f}" if isinstance(v, float) else str(v)) for v in r) + " |\n" for r in df.itertuples(index=False))
140	    return head + body

194	### quant-ml-canon-purged-cpcv-pbo (priority 1)
195	
196	**technique.** Validation harness: purged k-fold with embargo keyed on label end time, Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation (CPCV) backtest paths, CSCV probability of backtest overfitting (PBO), deflated Sharpe ratio, minimum backtest length, stationary block bootstrap of sessions, and a shared trials ledger for every candidate gate from H1-H5 and these studies.
197	
198	**what_it_answers.** Are the in-sample improvements of any candidate gate (rooms ST7/ST8, H2 regime, H3 volume, H4 levels, H5 rule lists, the studies below) larger than what picking the best of N trials produces by chance on 823 (5m) or a few thousand (1m) SETUPs? Which candidates have earned the single out-of-sample look? How many candidates can this sample afford before selection bias dominates?
199	
200	**method.** (1) Splitter module in the scratchpad, importable by every study: groups = 12 contiguous session blocks on IS (about 85 sessions each); purge = drop training SETUPs whose label lifetime [setup_i, label_exit_i] intersects the test block's bar range (label_exit_i = the label's own exit bar: the 15:25 bar for the intraday label, fnd_exit_i for the engine label which runs to 70 sessions on 5m and would purge a lot, one more reason to train on the intraday label); embargo = 3 sessions after each test block (longest feature memory: room age 3 sessions on 5m, vol_med60, range36, BSADF window 1 session). Exposes split(X, y, groups) so sklearn cross_val_predict and CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=iterable) accept it. (2) CPCV with N = 12 groups, k = 2 test groups: 66 purged train/test splits assembled into 11 full backtest paths per model; each study reports the distribution over paths (median, 5th percentile) of its kept-vs-skipped expectancy difference, control percentile and winner recall, not one number. (3) Trials ledger (CSV, append-only): one row per candidate configuration any study or H1-H5 evaluates, including every threshold a greedy search tries: candidate id, config JSON, label used, per-session IS net vector of the kept book, n_kept, script sha. (4) CSCV / PBO: matrix M candidates x T = 1,026 IS sessions of kept net per session; S = 16 blocks, all C(16,8) = 12,870 IS/OOS partitions; per partition the IS-best candidate (by mean kept net per session and, separately, by the kept-vs-skipped statistic) and its relative OOS rank; PBO = share of partitions with logit(rank) < 0; also the IS-vs-OOS performance degradation slope. (5) Deflated Sharpe ratio for each finalist: per-session Sharpe of the kept book, deflated by the expected maximum Sharpe under M trials (variance of Sharpe across the ledger), with skew and kurtosis of per-session net; p-value reported. (6) Minimum backtest length for the observed Sharpe and M, checked against T. (7) Stationary block bootstrap of sessions (Politis-Romano, mean block 10 sessions, 2,000 draws, seeded) for confidence intervals of kept-vs-skipped differences and control percentiles; this is the harness's only generative component. (8) Pre-registered go/no-go: a candidate goes to OOS only if PBO <= 0.2, the CPCV 5th-percentile kept-vs-skipped difference > 0 and DSR p < 0.1; at most three candidates across all lenses (one rule list, one model-based threshold, plus the frozen ST7/ST8 gate as comparator) are scored on OOS, by a separate script that reads frozen JSON. Outputs: the splitter, the ledger, a PBO/DSR table per timeframe, the go/no-go list.
201	
202	**leakage_controls.** The harness is the control for the other studies: purging by label end time removes train/test overlap of label lifetimes (holds past the entry session exist: 358 of 1,003 engine trades on 5m); the 3-session embargo covers feature memory; the ledger makes every trial visible so PBO counts them; the harness consumes IS per-session vectors only and never opens an OOS row; the OOS evaluator is a separate script reading frozen candidate JSON plus sha, run once; block-bootstrap and CPCV draws are seeded like fz_report.random_control so every number reproduces.
203	
204	**compute.** CPCV: 66 splits x 3 models per study that uses it, about 200 fits on <= 5k rows x 100 features, 10-15 CPU-minutes per timeframe; CSCV: precompute 16 block sums per candidate, then 12,870 partitions x M x 8 additions in numpy, seconds for M <= 2,000 (matrix 2,000 x 1,026 float64 = 16 MB); bootstrap 2,000 draws vectorised, under 1 minute; peak memory under 300 MB, one process.
205	
206	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, scipy.stats (skew, kurtosis, norm), itertools.combinations, joblib for caching; fz_report.random_control and permutation_p imported read-only as reference implementations; no new installs.
207	
208	**output_as_config.** Not trading numbers but provenance every ST13/ST14 file must carry: "validation": {"scheme": "purged_kfold_embargo", "blocks": 12, "embargo_sessions": 3, "cpcv_paths": 11, "label": "foundation_intraday_1525", "trials": M, "pbo": x, "dsr_p": y, "ledger_sha": ...} inside the strategy file's provenance object, plus the go/no-go table naming which candidates were allowed to touch OOS. The lab's existing random_control / permutation_p stay the headline statistics.
209	
210	**novelty.** Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial Machine Learning (2018) ch. 7 (purged k-fold, embargo), ch. 11-12 (backtest dangers, CPCV), ch. 14 (backtest statistics); Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu (2017) The probability of backtest overfitting, J. Computational Finance (CSCV/PBO); Bailey and Lopez de Prado (2014) The Deflated Sharpe Ratio, J. Portfolio Management; Harvey and Liu (2015) multiple-testing haircuts; Politis and Romano (1994) stationary bootstrap. Current because PBO/DSR with a trials ledger is what the 2020s quant-ML literature demands before an OOS claim, and the brief's H5 greedy threshold searches are exactly the multiplicity it measures.
211	
212	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: the ledger only counts trials that are logged, PBO/DSR over M threshold sweeps of one feature over-count independent trials while unlogged looks (dashboard, LLM summaries, the ST9-12 exit grid already run on 2026) under-count them, and the CSCV matrix on T = 1,026 sessions includes 447 IS sessions with no SETUP whose zero rows are identical across candidates and inflate per-session Sharpe. Fix: make the harness the only evaluator (evaluate(candidate) appends to the ledger as a side effect; no other code path may return a kept-vs-skipped number); report an effective trial count from the candidate-correlation matrix next to M; build CSCV/DSR/bootstrap on active sessions only (579 on 1m); merge study 15's SPA, adversarial drift and 5m null tapes into this harness so there is one bootstrap and one PBO; re-price every comparator (raw Foundation, frozen ST7/ST8) on the same L1 15:25 label the candidates use; stamp every OOS table with 'OOS window = published lab window and already used by the ST9-12 exit grid'.
213	
214	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 5 · expected value 4 · keep True — fix: Make this THE single harness: merge decision-making-3's (a)/(b) into it (one splitter = 12 contiguous IS session blocks, purge by the label's own exit bar, 3-session embargo; one append-only ledger; one PBO threshold 0.2, not 0.5). Expose score(candidate_json, label='L1') as the only way any study obtains a kept-vs-skipped number, so the ledger cannot be bypassed. Add the kept-n floors from decision-making-1 (kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300 on 1m / 80 on 5m) to the go/no-go so a tiny lucky subset cannot win the kept-vs-skipped statistic. Per-session Sharpe/DSR must use only sessions with a SETUP (579 of 1,026 IS sessions on 1m; the rest are structural zeros). The OOS evaluator is one script, run once, for at most 3 frozen candidates across all 18 studies; every other study's 'OOS once' clause is struck and replaced by 'submit to the harness'. Compute is minutes; peak < 300 MB is fine on the 759 MB currently free.

370	### decision-making-3-robustness-resampling-multiplicity-adversarial (priority 3)
371	
372	**technique.** Session-block stationary bootstrap, combinatorially symmetric cross-validation (PBO), Reality-Check/SPA multiplicity control over the whole candidate set, generative null tapes (session-bootstrap tapes and a GMM-Markov regime generator re-run through engine.run + fz.run), and adversarial validation for drift
373	
374	**what_it_answers.** Whether any gate / exit / sizing rule from studies 1, 2, 4, 5 has an edge that survives (a) resampling of sessions, (b) the number of candidates searched, (c) tapes generated from a null with no swing-structure memory (the edge should vanish there; if it does not, the gain is engine mechanics or cost avoidance), and (d) feature drift inside IS; and therefore whether a key may be written to strategy_13/14.json at all.
375	
376	**method.** (a) Stationary bootstrap (mean block 5 sessions, 2,000 draws) of the per-SETUP outcome table on IS: for EVERY candidate policy evaluated in studies 1/2/4/5 (the full logged search set, not just the selected ones) the distribution of kept-minus-skipped mean net and of the session-matched control percentile; White's Reality Check and Hansen's SPA p-value for "the best of M candidates beats the benchmark" with benchmark = Foundation and benchmark = the random gate at the same k. (b) CSCV / PBO: 16 contiguous session blocks, all C(16,8) = 12,870 IS/pseudo-OOS combinations, rank candidates in each half; PBO = share of combinations where the IS-best ranks below median out; also the deflated (haircut) expectancy after M trials. (c) Synthetic tapes fitted on IS bars only: (i) session-bootstrap tapes: whole sessions resampled with replacement, price level chained through session returns, gap distribution kept; (ii) GMM-Markov tapes: GaussianMixture (4-6 components, full covariance) on per-bar (log return, log volume ratio to the session-clock median, range/atr14, close position in bar) with a first-order Markov chain on the component labels fitted by transition counts, sampled per session with the time-of-day volume profile; (ii) preserves volatility clustering and volume shape but not swing/CHoCH memory, so it is the null. Each tape goes through engine.run, fz.run (ST7/ST8 blocks), the feature builder, the frozen study-1 gate and study-2 exit rules; report the kept-vs-skipped difference on (i) (stability) and on (ii) (should be ~0; its distribution is the multiplicity-free null for the real-tape statistic). Neural generators (TimeGAN, signature-WGAN, diffusion) are not runnable without torch and are named as not done. (d) Adversarial validation: HistGB classifier IS-early (2021-10..2023-09) vs IS-late (2023-10..2025-12) on the as-of features; AUC and SHAP-ranked drifted features; a selected rule that uses a top-5 drifted feature is refit without it and both versions are reported. IS-vs-OOS adversarial validation is run only AFTER each study's single OOS evaluation, label-free, as a declared post-mortem of any IS/OOS gap, never for selection.
377	
378	**leakage_controls.** All generators and drift models are fitted on IS bars/features only; OOS bars never enter a generator. The candidate set for SPA/PBO is the logged set from the other studies (every config evaluated, with its CV value), so multiplicity is counted, not guessed. Synthetic-tape features are rebuilt with the same causal builders (build_5m.py / 03_features.py logic) so the truncation-proof holds there too. The IS-vs-OOS adversarial check is ordered after the OOS evaluation and its result is reported as explanatory only.
379	
380	**compute.** (a)+(b): numpy on <= 5k rows x <= 200 candidates: 2-5 min. (c) 5m: engine.run 51 s + fz.run 11 s + features 20 s + replay ~ 1.5 min per 5-year tape; 20 tapes of each generator ~ 60 min total, < 600 MB. 1m: engine.run is 958 s per 5-year tape, so use 1-year synthetic tapes (~190 s engine + 5 s fz + 20 s features) x 8 tapes per generator ~ 60 min as a background job; peak ~ 900 MB (the 1m fz.run peaked at 892 MB), so it must not overlap study 2's 1m FQI. (d): < 2 min.
381	
382	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, pyarrow, scipy (stationary bootstrap, SPA), scikit-learn 1.7.2 (GaussianMixture, HistGradientBoostingClassifier), shap, engine.py / fz.py / fz_exec.py imported read-only with bytecode writing off
383	
384	**output_as_config.** No trading key. It writes the acceptance certificate that every shipped key must carry in its provenance block: {"spa_p": .., "pbo": .., "bootstrap_ci_kept_minus_skipped_inr": [lo, hi], "null_tape_diff_inr": {"p50": .., "p95": ..}, "drift_auc_is_early_vs_late": .., "drifted_features_used": [...]}, and a pre-registered pass rule: spa_p <= 0.10, pbo <= 0.5, bootstrap CI excluding 0, real-tape difference above the null-tape 95th percentile. A key that fails is recorded in STRATEGY_ANALYSIS_TODO (S49) as not surviving, and strategy_13/14 keep the sleeve as a card.
385	
386	**novelty.** Politis & Romano 1994 (stationary bootstrap); White 2000 (Reality Check) and Hansen 2005 (SPA) for best-of-M selection; Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado & Zhu 2017 (CSCV, probability of backtest overfitting) and Harvey, Liu & Zhu 2016 (multiple-testing haircuts); Lopez de Prado 2018 ch. 12-13 (synthetic data for backtest robustness); adversarial validation as the standard covariate-shift detector (Sugiyama et al. 2007 importance weighting; Kaggle practice). The GMM-Markov tape is the feasible stand-in for the neural generators the user's brief names; it is used as a null, which is the rigorous role for a generator here.
387	
388	**Judge 1** feasible 4 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: two harnesses (this and study 1) give two bootstraps and two PBOs on the same candidates; a GMM-Markov tape has too little short-horizon persistence, so its null is narrower than reality and over-rejects (false confidence); the 1m synthetic run (8 one-year tapes at 900 MB) yields one noisy null. Fix: merge into study 1's harness as its SPA, drift and null-tape sections; run null tapes on 5m only (20 full-length tapes, ~1 hour) and add a segment-bootstrap generator (30-bar blocks stitched across sessions) as a second null that keeps short autocorrelation; keep adversarial validation (2 minutes) and the 'refit without top-5 drifted features' rule; the pre-registered pass rule (spa_p <= 0.10, bootstrap CI excluding 0, real-tape difference above the null 95th percentile) becomes the harness's go/no-go.
389	
390	**Judge 2** feasible 3 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Parts (a) and (b) duplicate the harness: merge into quant-ml-canon-purged-cpcv-pbo with one ledger, one splitter and the stricter PBO <= 0.2 (0.5 is a coin flip). Keep (c) the null-tape test on 5m now (20 tapes x ~1.5 min, < 600 MB); the 1m tapes (fz.run peaked 892 MB) wait until lab.py exits, and use 1-year tapes as proposed. Keep (d) adversarial IS-early vs IS-late now (2 min) and the IS-vs-OOS check strictly after the single OOS run. Note that a time-of-day gate will read ~0 on GMM-Markov tapes by construction (no time-of-day return structure), which is the intended null, but a gate on stop distance or CHoCH counts can read non-zero through engine mechanics; interpret per the written rule.

    def __call__(self, *a):

    def name(self):

    return g

    """Descriptive terciles of an as-of column over the IS rows (pooled edges, recorded); NaN -> 'nan'."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    if edges is None: edges = np.nanquantile(x, q)

    return lab, [round(float(e), 4) for e in edges]

    keep = np.ones(T.n, dtype=bool); thrs = []

        best, n_elig = select_in_fold(T, cells, tr, f"{study}|cpcv|{T.tf}|{T.label}|{a}{b}")

    log(f"  CPCV 11 paths: diff median {dist['diff_median']} p5 {dist['diff_p5']} min {dist['diff_min']} share>0 {dist['diff_share_positive']} control pct median {dist.get('control_pct_median')} p5 {dist.get('control_pct_p5')}")
    return res, chosen, dist, prow, cp_chosen

    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(r["id"] for r in rows)); vecs = [H.load_vectors(i) for i in ids]
    fam = dict(ledger_rows=len(rows), candidates=len(ids), effective_trials=H.effective_trials(vecs) if len(vecs) > 1 else 1.0,
               pbo_diff=H.pbo(vecs, "diff"), pbo_kept_mean=H.pbo(vecs, "kept_mean"), spa=H.spa(vecs, tag=f"{study}|{tag}"))
    fam["spa_best_config"] = next((r["config"] for r in rows if r["id"] == ids[fam["spa"]["best"]]), None)
    v = H.load_vectors(nested_res["id"])
    fam["bootstrap_nested"] = H.bootstrap_ci(v, tag=f"{study}|{tag}|nested")

    def sharpe(vv):
        m = vv["kept_n"] > 0; s = vv["kept_sum"][m] / vv["kept_n"][m]
        return float(s.mean() / s.std(ddof=1)) if len(s) > 2 and s.std(ddof=1) else np.nan

    m = v["kept_n"] > 0
    fam["dsr_nested"] = H.deflated_sharpe(v["kept_sum"][m] / v["kept_n"][m], len(ids), float(srs.var(ddof=1)) if len(srs) > 1 else None)

GRID_COLS = ["cell", "id", "family", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "diff_top1_removed", "control_pct", "perm_p", "loser_recall",

def grid_frame(rows, extra_cols=()):
    cols = GRID_COLS + list(extra_cols)
    return pd.DataFrame([{c: r.get(c) for c in cols} for r in rows])


def candidate_json(study, tf, res, cfg_rules, statistic, script, note):
    return dict(study=study, timeframe=tf, label="L1", action="skip_setup_when", rules=cfg_rules,
                provenance=dict(source="learned on IS 2021-10..2025-12", script=os.path.basename(script), ledger_id=res["id"], statistic=statistic, note=note))


def trunc_diff_setups(full_df, trunc_df, cols, nb):
    """Causality check of new per-SETUP features: identical for every SETUP before the cut, or the feature is dropped."""
    a = full_df[full_df.setup_i < nb].reset_index(drop=True); b = trunc_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    out = dict(setups_before_cut=[int(len(a)), int(len(b))], differ=[])
    if len(a) != len(b): out["differ"] = ["ROW COUNT"]; return out
    for c in cols:
        x, y = a[c].astype(object).map(str), b[c].astype(object).map(str)
        if not (x == y).all(): out["differ"].append(c)
    out["PASS"] = len(out["differ"]) == 0
    return out

    tw = C.two_way(T, bucket(F.n_choch_since_bos, [1, 2, 3, 4], n5), F.hour_bin.astype(str).to_numpy(), "n_choch_since_bos", "hour_bin", rows)
    tw.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h2_{tag}_x_nchoch_hour.csv"), index=False)
    return D, edges


def run(tf, label):
    T = H.load(tf, label); tag = f"{tf}_{label}"

    rows = C.score_cells(T, cells, __file__, log)
    G = C.grid_frame(rows, ["fold_thresholds"])

    G.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h2_{tag}_grid.csv"), index=False)
    nested, chosen, dist, prow, cp_chosen = C.nested_cv(T, cells, "h2", __file__, log)
    pd.DataFrame([{k: r.get(k) for k in ["id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "winner_recall_weighted", "sign_blocks"]} | {"path": r["config"]["path"]} for r in prow]).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h2_{tag}_cpcv_paths.csv"), index=False)
    fam = C.family_stats(T, "h2", nested, dist, tag)
    log(f"  family: {fam['candidates']} candidates, eff {fam['effective_trials']}, PBO diff {fam['pbo_diff']['pbo']} kept {fam['pbo_kept_mean']['pbo']}, SPA p {fam['spa']['spa_p']} best {fam['spa_best_config']}, boot {fam['bootstrap_nested']['diff_ci']}, DSR p {fam['dsr_nested'].get('p')}, go {fam['go_no_go_nested']['passed']}")
    best_is = G.sort_values("diff", ascending=False).head(10)
    summ = dict(tf=tf, label=label, n_is=int(T.is_mask.sum()), all_mean=round(float(T.net[T.is_mask].mean()), 2), tercile_edges=edges, grid_cells=len(cells),
                grid_cells_go_raw=int(G.go_raw.sum()), grid_pct_ge95=int((G.control_pct >= 95).sum()), grid_diff_pos=int((G["diff"] > 0).sum()),
                top10_by_diff=best_is[["cell", "id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "sign_blocks", "go_raw"]].to_dict("records"),
                nested={k: nested.get(k) for k in C.GRID_COLS if k != "cell"} | dict(chosen_per_block=chosen),
                cpcv=dist, cpcv_chosen=cp_chosen, family=fam)
    C.jdump(summ, os.path.join(HERE, f"h2_{tag}_summary.json"))
    return summ


if __name__ == "__main__":
    log(f"h2_regime start {time.ctime()} ledger sha {H.ledger_sha()}")

    S["ledger_sha_after"] = H.ledger_sha(); S["run_s"] = round(time.time() - T0, 1)

"""H3 "visibly high volume" (BRIEF H3) through the harness. IS only; L1 primary, L0 robustness.

    python h3_volume.py [--tf minute|5minute] [--labels L1,L0]

Definitions (fixed before any number was read):
  high-volume bar   volume >= v x median(volume of the previous N bars of the same session, at least 5 of them), v in {2,3,4},
                    N in {20,60}; bars that are not the front month or have zero volume are never high-volume (bars.fm_na).
                    The N = 20 / 60 medians are recomputed here and asserted equal to bars.vol_med20_prior / vol_ratio20 / vol_ratio60.
  bar direction     sign(close - open): up / down / flat (flat bars are counted and excluded from the direction tables).
  aftermath (labels of the bar, from IS bars only, every window inside the bar's session, the full window required):
    fwd_{5,15,30}   sg x (close[j+n] - close[j]) in pts and / atr14[j]; share > 0
    mfe30 / mae30   max over j+1..j+30 of sg x (high|low - close[j]) / atr14 (the best excursion), min (the worst)
    high_held_n     max(high[j+1..j+n]) <= high[j];  low_held_n: min(low[j+1..j+n]) >= low[j];  n in {15, 30}
    own_extreme_held = the extreme in the bar's direction held (no continuation); opp_extreme_held = the other one held (respect)
    baseline        the same statistics over every IS bar with a defined ratio and a non-flat direction
  per SETUP (as-of, bars <= k; re-run on the truncated build and diffed): for each (v, N) the latest high-volume bar j of the
    session with j <= k (the SETUP bar itself counts, as the build's hv{2,3}_* do): hv_bars_since = k - j, hv_dir. For M in
    {5,15,30}: category agree (k - j <= M and hv_dir == dir), disagree (k - j <= M and hv_dir opposite), none (no such bar
    within M bars, or a flat bar). (v=2, N=20) and (v=3, N=20) are asserted equal to the build's hv2_* / hv3_* columns.
  gate cells (family h3/gate; 3 x 2 x 3 x 3 = 54 cells, each a ledger row): skip_if_disagree, skip_if_none, take_only_agree
    (= skip disagree and none) per (v, N, M). Nested CV chooses the cell inside each training fold (h234_common.nested_cv).
"""
import os, sys, json, time, argparse, itertools
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import h234_common as C
import harness as H

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("--tf", default="minute,5minute"); ap.add_argument("--labels", default="L1,L0"); A = ap.parse_args()
log = C.Log(os.path.join(HERE, "h3_volume.log"))
T0 = time.time()
VS, NS, MS = (2, 3, 4), (20, 60), (5, 15, 30)
GATES = ("skip_if_disagree", "skip_if_none", "take_only_agree")


def fwd_max(x, n, fill):
    """out[j] = max(x[j+1 .. j+n]) (NaN where the window runs past the array)."""
    pad = np.concatenate([x[1:], np.full(n, fill)])
    w = np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(pad, n)
    return w.max(axis=1)


def fwd_min(x, n, fill):
    pad = np.concatenate([x[1:], np.full(n, fill)])
    return np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(pad, n).min(axis=1)


def bar_frame(tf, folder):
    b = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, folder, "bars.parquet") if folder else os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, "bars.parquet"))
    V = b.volume.to_numpy(dtype=float); g = b.groupby("session_idx")["volume"]
    med = {N: g.transform(lambda s, N=N: s.shift(1).rolling(N, min_periods=5).median()).to_numpy() for N in NS}
    usable = ~b.fm_na.to_numpy()
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        ratio = {N: np.where(usable & (med[N] > 0), V / med[N], np.nan) for N in NS}
    if not folder:
        same = lambda x, y: bool(np.all((np.isnan(x) & np.isnan(y)) | (np.abs(x - y) <= 1e-9)))
        assert same(med[20], b.vol_med20_prior.to_numpy(dtype=float)) and same(ratio[20], b.vol_ratio20.to_numpy(dtype=float)) and same(ratio[60], b.vol_ratio60.to_numpy(dtype=float)), "volume baselines differ from the build"
    b["dir_num"] = np.sign(b.close.to_numpy() - b.open.to_numpy()).astype(int)
    for N in NS:
        b[f"ratio{N}"] = ratio[N]
        for v in VS:
            flag = np.where(np.isnan(ratio[N]), False, ratio[N] >= v)
            b[f"hv{v}_{N}"] = flag
            idx = pd.Series(np.where(flag, np.arange(len(b)), np.nan)); b[f"last_hv{v}_{N}"] = idx.groupby(b.session_idx.to_numpy()).ffill().to_numpy()
    b["last_i"] = b.groupby("session_idx")["i"].transform("max").to_numpy()
    return b


def aftermath(b):
    """The IS bar-level aftermath tables: per (v, N) x direction, plus the baseline."""
    isb = (b.split.to_numpy() == "IS")
    C_, Hh, Ll, A_ = (b[c].to_numpy(dtype=float) for c in ("close", "high", "low", "atr14"))
    last = b.last_i.to_numpy(); i = b.i.to_numpy(); d = b.dir_num.to_numpy()
    full = {n: (i + n <= last) for n in (5, 15, 30)}
    fwd = {n: np.where(full[n], np.roll(C_, -n) - C_, np.nan) for n in (5, 15, 30)}
    hi30, lo30 = fwd_max(Hh, 30, -np.inf), fwd_min(Ll, 30, np.inf)
    hi15, lo15 = fwd_max(Hh, 15, -np.inf), fwd_min(Ll, 15, np.inf)
    sg = d.astype(float)
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        mfe30 = np.where(full[30], np.where(sg > 0, hi30 - C_, C_ - lo30) / A_, np.nan)
        mae30 = np.where(full[30], np.where(sg > 0, lo30 - C_, C_ - hi30) / A_, np.nan)
        hh15, hh30 = np.where(full[15], hi15 <= Hh, np.nan), np.where(full[30], hi30 <= Hh, np.nan)
        lh15, lh30 = np.where(full[15], lo15 >= Ll, np.nan), np.where(full[30], lo30 >= Ll, np.nan)
    rows = []

    def stats(m, name, v, N, dr):
        m = m & isb
        r = dict(set=name, v=v, N=N, dir=dr, n=int(m.sum()))
        if r["n"] == 0: return r
        s = sg[m]
        for n in (5, 15, 30):
            f = s * fwd[n][m]; fa = f / A_[m]; ok = ~np.isnan(f)
            r.update({f"fwd{n}_n": int(ok.sum()), f"fwd{n}_pts_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(f)), 2), f"fwd{n}_atr_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(fa)), 3),
                      f"fwd{n}_atr_median": round(float(np.nanmedian(fa)), 3), f"fwd{n}_pos_share": round(float(np.nanmean(f[ok] > 0)), 4) if ok.any() else None,
                      f"fwd{n}_abs_atr_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(np.abs(fa))), 3)})
        r.update(mfe30_atr_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(mfe30[m])), 3), mfe30_atr_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(mfe30[m])), 3),
                 mae30_atr_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(mae30[m])), 3), mae30_atr_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(mae30[m])), 3),
                 high_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(hh15[m])), 4), high_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(hh30[m])), 4),
                 low_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(lh15[m])), 4), low_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(lh30[m])), 4))
        own15 = np.where(s > 0, hh15[m], lh15[m]); own30 = np.where(s > 0, hh30[m], lh30[m]); opp15 = np.where(s > 0, lh15[m], hh15[m]); opp30 = np.where(s > 0, lh30[m], hh30[m])
        r.update(own_extreme_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(own15)), 4), own_extreme_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(own30)), 4),
                 opp_extreme_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(opp15)), 4), opp_extreme_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(opp30)), 4))
        return r
    base_ok = ~np.isnan(b.ratio20.to_numpy())
    for dr, dm in (("up", d > 0), ("down", d < 0), ("both", d != 0)):
        rows.append(stats(base_ok & dm, "baseline_all_bars", None, 20, dr))
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        f = b[f"hv{v}_{N}"].to_numpy()
        rows.append(dict(set="hv_flat_count", v=v, N=N, dir="flat", n=int((f & isb & (d == 0)).sum())))
        for dr, dm in (("up", d > 0), ("down", d < 0), ("both", d != 0)):
            rows.append(stats(f & dm, "high_volume", v, N, dr))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def setup_feats(b, setups):
    """Per-SETUP as-of features for each (v, N): bars since the latest high-volume bar of the session (<= k) and its direction."""
    k = setups.setup_i.to_numpy(); out = pd.DataFrame(dict(setup_i=k))
    d = b.dir_num.to_numpy()
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        j = b[f"last_hv{v}_{N}"].to_numpy()[k]
        bs = np.where(np.isnan(j), np.nan, k - j)
        dn = np.where(np.isnan(j), 0, d[np.nan_to_num(j, nan=0).astype(int)])
        out[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"] = bs; out[f"hv{v}_{N}_dir"] = np.where(np.isnan(j), "none", np.where(dn > 0, "up", np.where(dn < 0, "down", "flat")))
    return out


def category(feat, v, N, M, sg):
    bs = feat[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr = feat[f"hv{v}_{N}_dir"].to_numpy().astype(str)
    hv_sg = np.where(dr == "up", 1, np.where(dr == "down", -1, 0))
    within = ~np.isnan(bs) & (bs <= M) & (hv_sg != 0)
    return np.where(~within, "none", np.where(hv_sg == sg, "agree", "disagree"))


def cells_h3(cats):
    cells = []
    for v, N, M, g in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS, GATES):
        key = (v, N, M)
        def ap_(T, r, t, key=key, g=g):
            c = cats[key][r]
            if g == "skip_if_disagree": return c != "disagree"
            if g == "skip_if_none": return c != "none"
            return c == "agree"
        cells.append(C.Cell("h3/gate", dict(v=v, N=N, M=M, gate=g), apply=ap_))
    return cells


def run(tf, label, b, feats, trunc):
    T = H.load(tf, label); tag = f"{tf}_{label}"
    log(f"== H3 {tag}: IS units {int(T.is_mask.sum())}")
    f = feats.set_index("setup_i").loc[T.F.setup_i.to_numpy()].reset_index()
    sg = np.where(T.F.dir.astype(str).to_numpy() == "up", 1, -1)
    # cross-check with the build's hv2_* / hv3_* (N = 20, M unbounded within the session)
    chk = {}
    for v in (2, 3):
        bs_b = T.F[f"hv{v}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr_b = T.F[f"hv{v}_dir"].astype(str).to_numpy()
        bs_m = f[f"hv{v}_20_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr_m = f[f"hv{v}_20_dir"].to_numpy().astype(str)
        chk[f"hv{v}_20"] = bool(np.all((np.isnan(bs_b) & np.isnan(bs_m)) | (bs_b == bs_m)) and np.all(dr_b == dr_m))
    log(f"  build cross-check hv2/hv3 (N=20): {chk}")
    assert all(chk.values()), chk
    cats = {(v, N, M): category(f, v, N, M, sg) for v, N, M in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS)}
    rows_is = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
    tabs = [C.bucket_table(T, cats[(v, N, M)], f"hv v{v} N{N} M{M}", rows_is, ["agree", "disagree", "none"]) for v, N, M in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS)]
    D = pd.concat(tabs, ignore_index=True); D.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_by_agreement.csv"), index=False)
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        bs = f[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        lab = np.where(np.isnan(bs), "none", np.where(bs == 0, "0", np.where(bs <= 5, "1-5", np.where(bs <= 15, "6-15", np.where(bs <= 30, "16-30", ">30")))))
        tabs.append(C.bucket_table(T, lab, f"hv v{v} N{N} bars_since", rows_is, ["0", "1-5", "6-15", "16-30", ">30", "none"]))
    pd.concat(tabs[len(list(itertools.product(VS, NS, MS))):], ignore_index=True).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_by_bars_since.csv"), index=False)
    cells = cells_h3(cats)
    rows = C.score_cells(T, cells, __file__, log)
    G = pd.concat([pd.DataFrame([r["config"] for r in rows]), C.grid_frame(rows)], axis=1)
    G.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_grid.csv"), index=False)
    nested, chosen, dist, prow, cp_chosen = C.nested_cv(T, cells, "h3", __file__, log)
    pd.DataFrame([{k: r.get(k) for k in ["id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "winner_recall_weighted", "sign_blocks"]} | {"path": r["config"]["path"]} for r in prow]).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_cpcv_paths.csv"), index=False)
    fam = C.family_stats(T, "h3", nested, dist, tag)
    log(f"  family: {fam['candidates']} candidates, eff {fam['effective_trials']}, PBO diff {fam['pbo_diff']['pbo']} kept {fam['pbo_kept_mean']['pbo']}, SPA p {fam['spa']['spa_p']} best {fam['spa_best_config']}, boot {fam['bootstrap_nested']['diff_ci']}, DSR p {fam['dsr_nested'].get('p')}, go {fam['go_no_go_nested']['passed']}")
    summ = dict(tf=tf, label=label, n_is=int(T.is_mask.sum()), build_crosscheck=chk, trunc_check=trunc, grid_cells=len(cells), grid_cells_go_raw=int(G.go_raw.sum()),
                grid_pct_ge95=int((G.control_pct >= 95).sum()), grid_diff_pos=int((G["diff"] > 0).sum()),
                top10_by_diff=G.sort_values("diff", ascending=False).head(10)[["cell", "id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "sign_blocks", "go_raw"]].to_dict("records"),
                nested={k: nested.get(k) for k in C.GRID_COLS if k != "cell"} | dict(chosen_per_block=chosen), cpcv=dist, cpcv_chosen=cp_chosen, family=fam)
    C.jdump(summ, os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_summary.json"))
    return summ


if __name__ == "__main__":
    log(f"h3_volume start {time.ctime()} ledger sha {H.ledger_sha()}")
    S = {}
    for tf in A.tf.split(","):
        b = bar_frame(tf, None)
        am = aftermath(b); am.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tf}_bar_aftermath.csv"), index=False)
        log(f"  {tf}: bar aftermath table {len(am)} rows; hv counts IS " + str({f"v{v}N{N}": int((b[f'hv{v}_{N}'] & (b.split == 'IS')).sum()) for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS)}))
        setups = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i"])
        feats = setup_feats(b, setups)
        # causality: the same features from the truncated build, identical for every SETUP before the cut
        bt = bar_frame(tf, C.CUT); st = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, C.CUT, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i"])
        ft = setup_feats(bt, st)
        trunc = C.trunc_diff_setups(feats, ft, [c for c in feats.columns if c != "setup_i"], len(bt)); trunc["cut"] = C.CUT
        log(f"  {tf}: truncation check {trunc}")
        assert trunc["PASS"], "new per-SETUP features are not causal"
        feats.to_parquet(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tf}_setup_hv_features.parquet"))
        del bt, ft
        for label in A.labels.split(","):
            S[f"{tf}/{label}"] = run(tf, label, b, feats, trunc)
    S["ledger_sha_after"] = H.ledger_sha(); S["run_s"] = round(time.time() - T0, 1)
    C.jdump(S, os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_summary_{A.tf.replace(',', '_')}.json"))
    log(f"h3 done in {S['run_s']}s; ledger sha {S['ledger_sha_after']}")

Definitions (fixed before any number was read):
  high-volume bar   volume >= v x median(volume of the previous N bars of the same session, at least 5 of them), v in {2,3,4},
                    N in {20,60}; bars that are not the front month or have zero volume are never high-volume (bars.fm_na).
                    The N = 20 / 60 medians are recomputed here and asserted equal to bars.vol_med20_prior / vol_ratio20 / vol_ratio60.
  bar direction     sign(close - open): up / down / flat (flat bars are counted and excluded from the direction tables).
  aftermath (labels of the bar, from IS bars only, every window inside the bar's session, the full window required):
    fwd_{5,15,30}   sg x (close[j+n] - close[j]) in pts and / atr14[j]; share > 0
    mfe30 / mae30   max over j+1..j+30 of sg x (high|low - close[j]) / atr14 (the best excursion), min (the worst)
    high_held_n     max(high[j+1..j+n]) <= high[j];  low_held_n: min(low[j+1..j+n]) >= low[j];  n in {15, 30}
    own_extreme_held = the extreme in the bar's direction held (no continuation); opp_extreme_held = the other one held (respect)
    baseline        the same statistics over every IS bar with a defined ratio and a non-flat direction
  per SETUP (as-of, bars <= k; re-run on the truncated build and diffed): for each (v, N) the latest high-volume bar j of the
    session with j <= k (the SETUP bar itself counts, as the build's hv{2,3}_* do): hv_bars_since = k - j, hv_dir. For M in
    {5,15,30}: category agree (k - j <= M and hv_dir == dir), disagree (k - j <= M and hv_dir opposite), none (no such bar
    within M bars, or a flat bar). (v=2, N=20) and (v=3, N=20) are asserted equal to the build's hv2_* / hv3_* columns.
  gate cells (family h3/gate; 3 x 2 x 3 x 3 = 54 cells, each a ledger row): skip_if_disagree, skip_if_none, take_only_agree
    (= skip disagree and none) per (v, N, M). Nested CV chooses the cell inside each training fold (h234_common.nested_cv).
"""
import os, sys, json, time, argparse, itertools
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import h234_common as C
import harness as H

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("--tf", default="minute,5minute"); ap.add_argument("--labels", default="L1,L0"); A = ap.parse_args()
log = C.Log(os.path.join(HERE, "h3_volume.log"))
T0 = time.time()
VS, NS, MS = (2, 3, 4), (20, 60), (5, 15, 30)
GATES = ("skip_if_disagree", "skip_if_none", "take_only_agree")


def fwd_max(x, n, fill):
    """out[j] = max(x[j+1 .. j+n]) (NaN where the window runs past the array)."""
    pad = np.concatenate([x[1:], np.full(n, fill)])
    w = np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(pad, n)
    return w.max(axis=1)


def fwd_min(x, n, fill):
    pad = np.concatenate([x[1:], np.full(n, fill)])
    return np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(pad, n).min(axis=1)


def bar_frame(tf, folder):
    b = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, folder, "bars.parquet") if folder else os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, "bars.parquet"))
    V = b.volume.to_numpy(dtype=float); g = b.groupby("session_idx")["volume"]
    med = {N: g.transform(lambda s, N=N: s.shift(1).rolling(N, min_periods=5).median()).to_numpy() for N in NS}
    usable = ~b.fm_na.to_numpy()
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        ratio = {N: np.where(usable & (med[N] > 0), V / med[N], np.nan) for N in NS}
    if not folder:
        same = lambda x, y: bool(np.all((np.isnan(x) & np.isnan(y)) | (np.abs(x - y) <= 1e-9)))
        assert same(med[20], b.vol_med20_prior.to_numpy(dtype=float)) and same(ratio[20], b.vol_ratio20.to_numpy(dtype=float)) and same(ratio[60], b.vol_ratio60.to_numpy(dtype=float)), "volume baselines differ from the build"
    b["dir_num"] = np.sign(b.close.to_numpy() - b.open.to_numpy()).astype(int)
    for N in NS:
        b[f"ratio{N}"] = ratio[N]
        for v in VS:
            flag = np.where(np.isnan(ratio[N]), False, ratio[N] >= v)
            b[f"hv{v}_{N}"] = flag
            idx = pd.Series(np.where(flag, np.arange(len(b)), np.nan)); b[f"last_hv{v}_{N}"] = idx.groupby(b.session_idx.to_numpy()).ffill().to_numpy()
    b["last_i"] = b.groupby("session_idx")["i"].transform("max").to_numpy()
    return b


def aftermath(b):
    """The IS bar-level aftermath tables: per (v, N) x direction, plus the baseline."""
    isb = (b.split.to_numpy() == "IS")
    C_, Hh, Ll, A_ = (b[c].to_numpy(dtype=float) for c in ("close", "high", "low", "atr14"))
    last = b.last_i.to_numpy(); i = b.i.to_numpy(); d = b.dir_num.to_numpy()
    full = {n: (i + n <= last) for n in (5, 15, 30)}
    fwd = {n: np.where(full[n], np.roll(C_, -n) - C_, np.nan) for n in (5, 15, 30)}
    hi30, lo30 = fwd_max(Hh, 30, -np.inf), fwd_min(Ll, 30, np.inf)
    hi15, lo15 = fwd_max(Hh, 15, -np.inf), fwd_min(Ll, 15, np.inf)
    sg = d.astype(float)
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        mfe30 = np.where(full[30], np.where(sg > 0, hi30 - C_, C_ - lo30) / A_, np.nan)
        mae30 = np.where(full[30], np.where(sg > 0, lo30 - C_, C_ - hi30) / A_, np.nan)
        hh15, hh30 = np.where(full[15], hi15 <= Hh, np.nan), np.where(full[30], hi30 <= Hh, np.nan)
        lh15, lh30 = np.where(full[15], lo15 >= Ll, np.nan), np.where(full[30], lo30 >= Ll, np.nan)
    rows = []

    def stats(m, name, v, N, dr):
        m = m & isb
        r = dict(set=name, v=v, N=N, dir=dr, n=int(m.sum()))
        if r["n"] == 0: return r
        s = sg[m]
        for n in (5, 15, 30):
            f = s * fwd[n][m]; fa = f / A_[m]; ok = ~np.isnan(f)
            r.update({f"fwd{n}_n": int(ok.sum()), f"fwd{n}_pts_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(f)), 2), f"fwd{n}_atr_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(fa)), 3),
                      f"fwd{n}_atr_median": round(float(np.nanmedian(fa)), 3), f"fwd{n}_pos_share": round(float(np.nanmean(f[ok] > 0)), 4) if ok.any() else None,
                      f"fwd{n}_abs_atr_mean": round(float(np.nanmean(np.abs(fa))), 3)})
        r.update(mfe30_atr_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(mfe30[m])), 3), mfe30_atr_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(mfe30[m])), 3),
                 mae30_atr_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(mae30[m])), 3), mae30_atr_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(mae30[m])), 3),
                 high_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(hh15[m])), 4), high_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(hh30[m])), 4),
                 low_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(lh15[m])), 4), low_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(lh30[m])), 4))
        own15 = np.where(s > 0, hh15[m], lh15[m]); own30 = np.where(s > 0, hh30[m], lh30[m]); opp15 = np.where(s > 0, lh15[m], hh15[m]); opp30 = np.where(s > 0, lh30[m], hh30[m])
        r.update(own_extreme_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(own15)), 4), own_extreme_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(own30)), 4),
                 opp_extreme_held_15=round(float(np.nanmean(opp15)), 4), opp_extreme_held_30=round(float(np.nanmean(opp30)), 4))
        return r
    base_ok = ~np.isnan(b.ratio20.to_numpy())
    for dr, dm in (("up", d > 0), ("down", d < 0), ("both", d != 0)):
        rows.append(stats(base_ok & dm, "baseline_all_bars", None, 20, dr))
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        f = b[f"hv{v}_{N}"].to_numpy()
        rows.append(dict(set="hv_flat_count", v=v, N=N, dir="flat", n=int((f & isb & (d == 0)).sum())))
        for dr, dm in (("up", d > 0), ("down", d < 0), ("both", d != 0)):
            rows.append(stats(f & dm, "high_volume", v, N, dr))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def setup_feats(b, setups):
    """Per-SETUP as-of features for each (v, N): bars since the latest high-volume bar of the session (<= k) and its direction."""
    k = setups.setup_i.to_numpy(); out = pd.DataFrame(dict(setup_i=k))
    d = b.dir_num.to_numpy()
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        j = b[f"last_hv{v}_{N}"].to_numpy()[k]
        bs = np.where(np.isnan(j), np.nan, k - j)
        dn = np.where(np.isnan(j), 0, d[np.nan_to_num(j, nan=0).astype(int)])
        out[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"] = bs; out[f"hv{v}_{N}_dir"] = np.where(np.isnan(j), "none", np.where(dn > 0, "up", np.where(dn < 0, "down", "flat")))
    return out


def category(feat, v, N, M, sg):
    bs = feat[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr = feat[f"hv{v}_{N}_dir"].to_numpy().astype(str)
    hv_sg = np.where(dr == "up", 1, np.where(dr == "down", -1, 0))
    within = ~np.isnan(bs) & (bs <= M) & (hv_sg != 0)
    return np.where(~within, "none", np.where(hv_sg == sg, "agree", "disagree"))


def cells_h3(cats):
    cells = []
    for v, N, M, g in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS, GATES):
        key = (v, N, M)
        def ap_(T, r, t, key=key, g=g):
            c = cats[key][r]
            if g == "skip_if_disagree": return c != "disagree"
            if g == "skip_if_none": return c != "none"
            return c == "agree"
        cells.append(C.Cell("h3/gate", dict(v=v, N=N, M=M, gate=g), apply=ap_))
    return cells


def run(tf, label, b, feats, trunc):
    T = H.load(tf, label); tag = f"{tf}_{label}"
    log(f"== H3 {tag}: IS units {int(T.is_mask.sum())}")
    f = feats.set_index("setup_i").loc[T.F.setup_i.to_numpy()].reset_index()
    sg = np.where(T.F.dir.astype(str).to_numpy() == "up", 1, -1)
    # cross-check with the build's hv2_* / hv3_* (N = 20, M unbounded within the session)
    chk = {}
    for v in (2, 3):
        bs_b = T.F[f"hv{v}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr_b = T.F[f"hv{v}_dir"].astype(str).to_numpy()
        bs_m = f[f"hv{v}_20_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float); dr_m = f[f"hv{v}_20_dir"].to_numpy().astype(str)
        chk[f"hv{v}_20"] = bool(np.all((np.isnan(bs_b) & np.isnan(bs_m)) | (bs_b == bs_m)) and np.all(dr_b == dr_m))
    log(f"  build cross-check hv2/hv3 (N=20): {chk}")
    assert all(chk.values()), chk
    cats = {(v, N, M): category(f, v, N, M, sg) for v, N, M in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS)}
    rows_is = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
    tabs = [C.bucket_table(T, cats[(v, N, M)], f"hv v{v} N{N} M{M}", rows_is, ["agree", "disagree", "none"]) for v, N, M in itertools.product(VS, NS, MS)]
    D = pd.concat(tabs, ignore_index=True); D.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_by_agreement.csv"), index=False)
    for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS):
        bs = f[f"hv{v}_{N}_bars_since"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        lab = np.where(np.isnan(bs), "none", np.where(bs == 0, "0", np.where(bs <= 5, "1-5", np.where(bs <= 15, "6-15", np.where(bs <= 30, "16-30", ">30")))))
        tabs.append(C.bucket_table(T, lab, f"hv v{v} N{N} bars_since", rows_is, ["0", "1-5", "6-15", "16-30", ">30", "none"]))
    pd.concat(tabs[len(list(itertools.product(VS, NS, MS))):], ignore_index=True).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_by_bars_since.csv"), index=False)
    cells = cells_h3(cats)
    rows = C.score_cells(T, cells, __file__, log)
    G = pd.concat([pd.DataFrame([r["config"] for r in rows]), C.grid_frame(rows)], axis=1)
    G.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_grid.csv"), index=False)
    nested, chosen, dist, prow, cp_chosen = C.nested_cv(T, cells, "h3", __file__, log)
    pd.DataFrame([{k: r.get(k) for k in ["id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "winner_recall_weighted", "sign_blocks"]} | {"path": r["config"]["path"]} for r in prow]).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_cpcv_paths.csv"), index=False)
    fam = C.family_stats(T, "h3", nested, dist, tag)
    log(f"  family: {fam['candidates']} candidates, eff {fam['effective_trials']}, PBO diff {fam['pbo_diff']['pbo']} kept {fam['pbo_kept_mean']['pbo']}, SPA p {fam['spa']['spa_p']} best {fam['spa_best_config']}, boot {fam['bootstrap_nested']['diff_ci']}, DSR p {fam['dsr_nested'].get('p')}, go {fam['go_no_go_nested']['passed']}")
    summ = dict(tf=tf, label=label, n_is=int(T.is_mask.sum()), build_crosscheck=chk, trunc_check=trunc, grid_cells=len(cells), grid_cells_go_raw=int(G.go_raw.sum()),
                grid_pct_ge95=int((G.control_pct >= 95).sum()), grid_diff_pos=int((G["diff"] > 0).sum()),
                top10_by_diff=G.sort_values("diff", ascending=False).head(10)[["cell", "id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "control_pct", "perm_p", "sign_blocks", "go_raw"]].to_dict("records"),
                nested={k: nested.get(k) for k in C.GRID_COLS if k != "cell"} | dict(chosen_per_block=chosen), cpcv=dist, cpcv_chosen=cp_chosen, family=fam)
    C.jdump(summ, os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tag}_summary.json"))
    return summ


if __name__ == "__main__":
    log(f"h3_volume start {time.ctime()} ledger sha {H.ledger_sha()}")
    S = {}
    for tf in A.tf.split(","):
        b = bar_frame(tf, None)
        am = aftermath(b); am.to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tf}_bar_aftermath.csv"), index=False)
        log(f"  {tf}: bar aftermath table {len(am)} rows; hv counts IS " + str({f"v{v}N{N}": int((b[f'hv{v}_{N}'] & (b.split == 'IS')).sum()) for v, N in itertools.product(VS, NS)}))
        setups = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i"])
        feats = setup_feats(b, setups)
        # causality: the same features from the truncated build, identical for every SETUP before the cut
        bt = bar_frame(tf, C.CUT); st = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(C.OUT, "data", tf, C.CUT, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i"])
        ft = setup_feats(bt, st)
        trunc = C.trunc_diff_setups(feats, ft, [c for c in feats.columns if c != "setup_i"], len(bt)); trunc["cut"] = C.CUT
        log(f"  {tf}: truncation check {trunc}")
        assert trunc["PASS"], "new per-SETUP features are not causal"
        feats.to_parquet(os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_{tf}_setup_hv_features.parquet"))
        del bt, ft
        for label in A.labels.split(","):
            S[f"{tf}/{label}"] = run(tf, label, b, feats, trunc)
    S["ledger_sha_after"] = H.ledger_sha(); S["run_s"] = round(time.time() - T0, 1)
    C.jdump(S, os.path.join(HERE, f"h3_summary_{A.tf.replace(',', '_')}.json"))
    log(f"h3 done in {S['run_s']}s; ledger sha {S['ledger_sha_after']}")
